item.title: US execution survivor Christa Pike says she is now in ‘constant pain’
item.description: Pike, 50, is being held in solitary confinement and faces an uncertain future after surviving a failed lethal injection. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Georgia Senate race has Jewish voters weigh Ossoff's Israel criticism, Collins' far-right ties
item.description: Georgia's Senate election pits a Jewish Democrat who voted against certain Israel arms sales against a Republican facing scrutiny over family and former staff members' far-right views. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Russia’s Novaya Gazeta ‘killed off’ after murders, arrests and pressure
item.description: Russia’s most prominent investigative newspaper is closing, with staff accusing the government of killing it off. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Ebola death toll in DR Congo passes 5,000
item.description: Authorities ​are struggling to find a way to control the ⁠outbreak, with no approved treatments or vaccines. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Hundreds evacuated from Melania-brokered ceasefire town of Oleshky
item.description: Hundreds have been evacuated from Russia-occupied Oleshky under a localised ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Poland’s president joins protest amid constitutional crisis at top court
item.description: Poland’s president has cut short a trip to Senegal, joining protesters facing off with police. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Israel's Arab parties emerge from deadlocked election as kingmakers
item.description: A record turnout of Arabs, many of whom identify as Palestinian citizens of Israel, tipped the political scales in the election and turned the Arab-majority parties into kingmakers in a deadlocked result. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Caitlin Kelly

item.title: US approves $3 billion Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said earlier this week that Ukraine had been waiting for almost a month for the US to sign off on critical ​missile supplies. Publicado también por: BBC News - World, The Jerusalem Post - International. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Pope Leo becomes first pontiff to vote in US general election
item.description: The Chicago-born pontiff, who has a tense relationship with Trump, mailed in a ballot for the midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Los escenarios para formar gobierno en Israel con Netanyahu y Eisenkot sin mayoría absoluta
item.description: Tras una participación récord en las elecciones en Israel, el bloque del primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu logró el mayor número de escaños, 53 de 120, pero no consiguió los suficientes para formar gobierno. La oposición, liderada por Gadi Eisenkot, logró 48 escaños, pero al quedar por debajo de los 61 necesarios para lograr la mayoría absoluta, por lo que, al igual que el oficialismo, deben considerar los diferentes escenarios, que incluyen buscar alianzas con los partidos árabes. Publicado también por: BBC News Mundo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: G20 talks expose deep rift as Russia stays defiant while Rubio pursues sideline diplomacy
item.description: Russia showed no sign on Friday of softening its stance on Kyiv as G20 foreign ministers opened talks in the United States, with the Ukraine and Iran wars deepening rifts between the sprawling forum’s members. Sharp disagreements emerged around the table, with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas accusing Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov of presenting “lies” on issues like the conflict in Ukraine. “He put forward a lot of lies, a lot of false narratives” that Europeans were able to push... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: What are U.S. midterm elections?
item.description: The U.S. midterm elections on November 3 determine control of Congress, with all 435 House seats, about one-third of the 100 Senate seats, and numerous state governorships up for grabs, in a nationwide vote that weakens or strengthens the President’s agenda depending on which party prevails. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English. Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Fake polls expose vulnerabilities in US elections ahead of midterms
item.description: Fabricated surveys are adding to tensions in the country's increasingly polarised political environment. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Dog walker threatened with gun during ICE arrest in North Hollywood
item.description: Footage shows masked ICE agents pointing a handgun at a bystander walking his dogs as they arrest another man in the US. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Poland's president turns back from Senegal trip as court chief's ousting sparks crisis
item.description: Riot police were deployed to Poland's Constitutional Tribunal on Friday as hundreds of demonstrators gathered to protest against the suspension of the top court's president by the current pro-European government. Publicado también por: The Jerusalem Post - International. Fuente: Sky News - World.

item.title: Halloween Protests & French Promises, US Mid Term Mood, What now for Israel?
item.description: France braces for another weekend of unrest as the Yellow Vests return to the streets under the rallying cry of ‘Act III – Halloween’, with 70,000 police and security forces deployed after the riots and looting of recent weeks. A cash-strapped government faces mounting grievances, a rolling protest movement and little room for manoeuvre ahead of elections, as it struggles to restore order while grappling with crippling debt. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Gavin LEE

item.title: Germany and France brace for protests on Halloween weekend
item.description: A wave of youth-led protests has swept Europe, with demonstrators denouncing rising prices and a lack of prospects. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.
